Subject: Onboarding: privacy addenda & telemetry for pilot

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we prep for a short pilot with a subset of credit-application flows, Procurement and InfoSec asked me to collect a few items before we can spin up test workloads in our environment:

1) A draft GLBA addendum (we may need GLBA + DPA language together)
2) A short list of subprocessors (cloud regions + any analytics vendors) and whether you support regional restriction for data residency
3) Telemetry/observability schema for request/response logs and per-request routing metadata (we need to prove logs will include pseudonymous request ids, timestamps, model variant, and region)
4) Retention windows for logs and options to purge
5) A sample ingress IP allowlist and DocuSign link for our procurement form once terms are close

I've attached our baseline requirements workbook to make it easier to map items to your controls. Can you provide the items above, and an estimated timeline for a pilot-ready sandbox (2–3 tenants with live traffic)?

Appreciate it —
Bethany
Senior PM, Compliance
Midland Lender
[Attachment: midland-privacy-requirements-v1.xlsx]
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Onboarding: privacy addenda & telemetry for pilot

Hi Bethany —

Thanks — this is great and very actionable. Quick responses below; tagging Markus for the telemetry/residency bits and Vanessa for procurement/contract sequencing.

High level answers:
- Draft GLBA + DPA: attaching our current DPA with a proposed GLBA addendum section. Legal is OK to start markups; we can scope any GLBA-specific logging obligations into the addendum.
- Subprocessors: we have a short list (cloud infra + monitoring) — we can provide either the full list or a restricted subset for the pilot.
- Residency / regional restriction: we support region affinity and can pin requests to us-east-1 or eu-west-1 for Dedicated/Private modes. Hosted mode supports region routing but not hard residency guarantees unless Dedicated is provisioned.
- Telemetry: Markus will share a compact telemetry schema and an example log extract (pseudonymized IDs; we never log raw PII). We also offer a telemetry ingestion endpoint or SFTP delivery for customers who want to ship logs to their SIEM.
- Retention & purge: default 90 days for request traces; can be shortened for pilots and we support on-demand purge APIs.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-draft_20260901.pdf (DPA + GLBA stub), telemetry-specs-20260902.xlsx

Timeline: internal engineering can stand up a sandbox with region affinity in ~7 business days once SSO and billing are complete; Dedicated provisioning would take longer (2–3 weeks).

Next steps: 1) Markus to share telemetry extract and subprocessor list; 2) Vanessa to send procurement checklist and DocuSign link; 3) Legal exchange DPA markups.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Adding technical detail for Procurement/InfoSec: please find inline answers and a small exemplar log below. I attached a compact telemetry spreadsheet with column definitions.

Residency / Subprocessors:
- Primary infra: AWS (us-east-1) — subprocessor: Amazon Web Services, Inc.; also use Datadog for metrics and S3 for transient artifacts.
- For pilot we can request a residency-only stack: requests routed to us-east-1 and logs retained in a customer-scoped S3 bucket (encrypted).
- We can also provide a signed subprocessor appendix restricting analytics export for the pilot.

Telemetry schema (example fields):
- request_id (uuid, pseudonymized)
- tenant_id
- route/model (e.g., gpt-redwood-1-8b-quantized)
- region
- tokens_in / tokens_out
- processing_latency_ms
- cache_hit (boolean)

Example log (pseudonymized):
[2026-09-02T12:20:15Z] request_id=3f4e9a2b tenant_id=T-234 route=gpt-redwood-1-8b-quantized region=us-east-1 tokens_in=42 tokens_out=87 latency_ms=68 cache_hit=false

Retention / Purge:
- Default trace retention: 90 days. For pilot we can set 7/30/90-day buckets.
- Purge API: POST /v1/admin/purge?tenant_id=... (audit trail recorded via immutable event log).

Security controls:
- All logs encrypted at rest (AES-256).
- KMS-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private deployments (customer-managed keys available on Private)
- SOC2 Type II report available; can share under NDA

Attachments: telemetry-specs-20260902.xlsx (schema & samples)

Happy to hop on a short tech call with your engineers to show the log flows and S3 delivery model.

— Markus
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: telemetry-specs-20260902.xlsx]

3) Timeline: we want sandbox live by Sept 14 to meet credit-cycle testing. Is that feasible if we get DocuSign today?

If you can confirm 1–3, we can push procurement to sign and get SSO details.
